Humanoid (Dwarf) · 1 hex · SM -1 Duergar [Monsters on Automatic, SRD coverage: humanoid folk and their sub-races; answers Duergar (SRD 5.1); Duergar (SRD 3.5)]

Grey, hairless dwarves who kept the craft and lost everything else. Duergar work mines with slave labour, resent every hour of it, and are joyless in a way that reads as menace long before anyone draws. They can simply stop being visible, which they do without ceremony and usually about four seconds before it matters.

Notes

  • GCS ancestry draft: gcs/duergar.gct
  • Independent build total: 102 points of racial traits plus 24 points of racial skills.
  • Answers the SRD heading(s): Duergar (SRD 5.1); Duergar (SRD 3.5). Only the creature identity is taken from the SRD; the GURPS statistics, ratings and prose are this project's own work and reproduce no SRD text.
  • Typical Stats, damage and ratings are derived from the racial template, not authored beside it, so the sheet and the stat block cannot disagree.
  • Body mass used to scale this build: 70 kg. ST, Size Modifier and DR are checked against it; see the gurps-animal-sanity-check skill for the bands.
  • Movement: ground Move 4 (primary). The published Move is the primary medium's cruising Move; sprint figures are stated here and not folded into it.
  • Treasure and grappling are not authored for this batch and ship as explicit nulls; `lair` carries a short habitat note, because where a wandering animal dens is an encounter fact rather than a loot one.
  • About 1.3 m standing, which is the SM -1 row.
  • ST 11 from the dwarf stock: the frame is the same, and nothing about the grey did anything to it.
  • Invisibility is bought Switchable at the published +10%. Always-on invisibility would describe a creature its own war band could not see, which is not this one.
  • The enlargement duergar can call on is not built: it changes Size Modifier, ST and reach for a few minutes, and the package has no contract for a record whose statistics move during an encounter. It belongs in the prose and in a GM's hands until there is one.
  • Mail and a heavy shield are the usual kit and are not in this record's DR. See decision 11 in the build policy.
